replies.body:
Yo 99

I'm gonna put this under review because there is a known visual glitch that occasionally occurs that makes certain players appear to be sneaking while running.
It only happens for a short period of time before it stops. A similar visual glitch occurs with regards to players appearing like they're blocking their sword while running.

Ill get some more opinions first, personally I think he's all g but I'll get back to you on this.
